# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release on the default branch receives security fixes. Historical review documents describe past findings and are not supported software versions.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not include secrets, personal data, working exploit payloads, or tenant data in a public issue. Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting when it is enabled, or contact the repository owner through a private channel listed on their GitHub profile.

Include the affected version, deployment mode, reproduction steps, expected and observed behavior, impact, and a minimal proof of concept using synthetic data. Reports are handled on a best-effort basis; this personal project does not offer a commercial response SLA.

Please allow a reasonable remediation period before public disclosure. No test authorization is granted for systems, accounts, data, or infrastructure that you do not own.
